units.source_text: 源氏公子猜度：“那么，那女孩是这女儿所生的了。”

en.t: Prince Genji guessed, "Then that girl must be the child born to this daughter."

units.source_text: 又想：“这样看来，这女孩是兵部卿亲王的血统，是我那意中人的侄女，所以面貌相像。”

en.t: He also thought, "Seen this way, the girl is of Prince Hyobukyo's bloodline, and she is the niece of the woman I long for, which is why their faces resemble each other."
He felt even more affection for her.

units.source_text: 接着又想：“这女孩出身高贵，品貌又端丽，幼年毫无妒忌之心，对人容易投合，我可随心所欲地教养她长大起来。”

en.t: Then he thought again, "This girl is nobly born, graceful in bearing and lovely in appearance. Being young, she has no jealousy in her heart and easily grows attached to others, so I could raise her exactly as I wish."

units.source_text: 他想明确这女孩的来历，又探问：“真不幸啊！

en.t: Wanting to make the girl's background clear, he asked further, "How truly unfortunate!

units.source_text: 那么这位小姐有没有生育呢？”

en.t: Then did that young lady have any children?"

units.source_text: 僧都答道：“病死之前生了一个孩子，也是女的，现在靠外婆抚养。

en.t: The bishop replied, "Before she died of illness, she gave birth to one child, also a girl, who is now being raised by her grandmother.

units.source_text: 但这老尼姑残年多病，照料这外孙女不免辛劳，常常叹苦呢。”

en.t: But the old nun is sickly in her remaining years, and caring for this granddaughter is inevitably hard for her, so she often laments her troubles."
Prince Genji thought: just as I expected!

units.source_text: 便进一步开言道：“我有一个不情之请：可否相烦向老师姑商量，将这女孩托付与我抚养？

en.t: He then went on to say, "I have an unreasonable request: might I trouble you to consult the old nun and have this girl entrusted to me to raise?

units.source_text: 我虽已有妻室，但因我对人生另有见解，与这妻子不能融洽，经常独居一室。

en.t: Although I already have a wife, my view of life is different, and I cannot live in harmony with her, so I often stay alone in my own room.

units.source_text: 但恐你等将我看作寻常之人，以为年龄太不相称，此事不甚妥当吧？”

en.t: But I fear you may see me as an ordinary man and think the difference in age is far too unsuitable, making this matter improper."
